reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect to S-Miles Home
reauth_confirm.description: Enter the password for the existing account. Your plant, entities and history are retained.

user.title: Connect to S-Miles Home
user.description: Choose the account type matching your official app. Installer is experimental: live readings and energy totals only; no controls or additional device telemetry.

select_station.title: Select your plant
select_station.description: Choose a plant by its name and station ID. You can also type a numeric station ID directly into the dropdown. Do not use an inverter serial number.

manual_station.title: Enter your station ID
manual_station.description: Enter the numeric station ID of your plant. In S-Miles Cloud, select your plant and check the URL of its detail page. This is not the inverter serial number.

error.invalid_station: No devices were found for this station ID. Check the number and account access.
error.discovery_failed: Could not load the plant list. You can enter the station ID manually.
error.no_stations: The account returned no plants in its list. If you know your station ID, you can enter it manually.
error.invalid_station_id: Enter a positive numeric station ID.

settings_refresh_wait.message: Wait at least 30 seconds between manual settings refreshes.

battery_setting_write_failed.message: The battery setting could not be saved: {error}

device_setting_write_failed.message: The device setting could not be confirmed: {error}

init.title: Station settings
init.description: Compare the PV power sensor attributes pv and pv2 with the S-Miles Home app. Select another source only after confirming the match. Automatic preserves the existing behavior: pv2 when available, otherwise pv; zero is a valid value. This changes only the display in HA. Battery temperatures are read automatically at most every five minutes. Additional inverter telemetry is optional. Select the actual station timezone for daily boundaries and charts. Battery commands are disabled by default, including after an upgrade. Enable battery controls only if Home Assistant should change the mode, reserve SOC and separate charge/discharge cutoffs. Cutoffs and output power add reads every 30 minutes. Output power is bounded by the freshly reported maximum; the new control still needs device testing. Avoid simultaneous changes in the S-Miles Home app. Device controls additionally read heating and display settings every 30 minutes and are separately disabled by default. The heating switch permits automatic heating; it does not force the heater to run. Available lighting functions depend on the device.

data.device_controls: Allow device controls (heating, light and display; beta)
data.battery_controls: Allow battery controls (mode, SOC and output power)
